mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.customer_name name FROM bike_customer c JOIN bike_user_customer_scope s ON s.customer_id=c.id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND c.status='ENABLED'
SELECT id,customer_name name FROM bike_customer WHERE id=#{customerId} AND status='ENABLED'

SELECT m.id,m.model_name name, GREATEST(0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle v WHERE v.model_id=m.id AND v.status=2 AND NOT ) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.qty) FROM () c WHERE c.model_id=m.id),0) ) available_qty FROM bike_product_model m WHERE m.enabled=1 ORDER BY m.model_name,m.id
mapper.sql: SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,c.customer_name,i.model_id,i.model_name,i.order_qty,i.shipped_qty,o.status,o.planned_ship_date,o.remark,o.created_at FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT oi.order_id,MIN(oi.product_model_id) model_id,GROUP_CONCAT(m.model_name ORDER BY m.model_name SEPARATOR '、') model_name,SUM(oi.ordered_qty) order_qty,SUM(oi.shipped_qty) shipped_qty FROM bike_sales_order_item oi JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=oi.product_model_id GROUP BY oi.order_id) i ON i.order_id=o.id
mapper.select: WHERE o.customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_sales_order WHERE customer_id=#{customerId}

SELECT CAST(business_id AS UNSIGNED) order_id, JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.customerId') customer_id, JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.modelId') model_id, JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.quantity') quantity, CAST(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.plannedShipDate')),'null') AS DATE) planned_ship_date, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.remark')),'null') remark FROM bike_operation_log WHERE business_type='CUSTOMER_ORDER_SUBMIT' AND operator_id=#{userId} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_data,'$.requestId'))=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_operation_log(business_type,business_id,action,operator_id,after_data) VALUES('CUSTOMER_ORDER_SUBMIT',#{orderId},'客户下单幂等记录',#{userId},JSON_OBJECT('requestId',#{request.requestId},'customerId',#{customerId},'modelId',#{request.modelId},'quantity',#{request.quantity},'plannedShipDate',#{request.plannedShipDate},'remark',#{remark}))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM bike_customer WHERE customer_code=#{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_sys_role(role_code,role_name,enabled) VALUES('WEB_CUSTOMER','客户',1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_code=VALUES(role_code)
INSERT INTO bike_sys_user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{userId},id FROM bike_sys_role WHERE role_code='WEB_CUSTOMER' AND enabled=1
mapper.select: WHERE o.status='PENDING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_operation_log l WHERE l.business_type='CUSTOMER_ORDER_SUBMIT' AND CAST(l.business_id AS UNSIGNED)=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_operation_log r WHERE r.business_type='CUSTOMER_ORDER_READ' AND CAST(r.business_id AS UNSIGNED)=o.id AND r.operator_id=#{userId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_user_customer_scope s WHERE s.customer_id=o.customer_id AND s.user_id=#{scopeUserId}) ORDER BY o.created_at,o.id LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_operation_log WHERE business_type='CUSTOMER_ORDER_SUBMIT' AND CAST(business_id AS UNSIGNED)=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_operation_log(business_type,business_id,action,operator_id) SELECT 'CUSTOMER_ORDER_READ',#{orderId},'已读客户订单提醒',#{userId} WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_operation_log WHERE business_type='CUSTOMER_ORDER_READ' AND CAST(business_id AS UNSIGNED)=#{orderId} AND operator_id=#{userId})
